title: Q2 Results Highlights, 15th Oct: Wipro PAT rises 9% year-on-year; Tech Mahindra profit jumps 32.7%; Nestlé shares tank after Q2 results; IIFL Finance, IRFC, Polycab, KVB and HDFC AMC report higher PAT
text:
Two investors are working together with analyzing the stock data graphs in the paper and viewing the data on the laptop screen. istock photo for BL | Photo Credit: wutwhanfoto

Q2 Results Today, 15th October 2026: Find all the latest Q2 results 2026 updates of 360 ONE WAM, Tata Communications, Tech Mahindra, Tips Music, Wipro, HDFC Life, Indian Bank, IRFC, HDFC AMC,Persistent Systems and Neslte.

LOSERS: MRPL, HDB Financial, CEAT, Canara Bank

Follow our stock market live here | Stay tuned to businessline for more

Wipro: Standalone PAT at ₹2862.7 crore in Q2FY27, up 9%

Nestle India: Q2 PAT rises 36% to ₹1026.7 crore

Karur Vysya Bank: Logs 37.2% y-o-y increase in net profit to ₹787.69 crore

Heritage Foods: Standalone PAT down 36.9% in Q2FY27

HDFC AMC: Standalone net profit up 4% y-o-y

Polycab India: Standalone PAT rises 44% y-o-y to ₹965.2 cr

Tata Communications: Con. PAT rises to ₹335.61 cr in Q2

Tech Mahindra: Net profit jumps 32.7% to ₹1,586 crore, revenue rises 15.6%

Tech Mahindra’s Q2 FY27 net profit rose 32.7% to ₹1,586 crore, revenue grew 15.6% to ₹16,180 crore and new deal wins reached $1.02 billion.

Dairy firm Heritage Foods Ltd on Thursday reported 39 per cent decline in consolidated net profit at Rs 30.85 crore for the quarter ended September despite higher income.

Its net profit stood at Rs 50.99 crore in the year-ago period.

Total income rose to Rs 1,322.94 crore in the second quarter of this fiscal from Rs 1,117.68 crore a year ago, according to a regulatory filing. - PTI

IIFL Finance reported standalone PAT of Rs 548.53 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 210.72 crore in Q2FY26.

HDFC Life Insurance Company posted standalone PAT of Rs 508 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 447.15 crore in Q2FY26.

Approved Fund raising through issuance of NCDs in the nature of subordinated debt instruments up to ₹ 500 crore;

The establishment of an IIO of the Company at GIFT IFSC will enable the Company to leverage the opportunities available within the IFSC ecosystem.

Persistent Systems reported standalone PAT of Rs 482.89 crore in Q2FY27 (+5.%) as against Rs 458.9 crore in Q2FY26.

Wipro's Q2 revenue rose 9.1% to ₹24,753 crore, beating estimates as European client spending revived and artificial intelligence opened new revenue streams.

Wipro posted 9.5% increase in standalone PAT to Rs 2862.7 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 2614.2 crore in Q2FY26.

Sensex settled 1533.72 pts or 2.11% higher at 74,315.61 on Thursday, and Nifty 50 gained 374.65 pts or 1.66% to end at 22,997.35. Private bank, IT and Auto were top sectoral movers. PSU Bank, Media, FMCG were major laggards.

Milk procurement growth: Volumes increased 7% YoY in Q2 and 4% in H1 despite monsoon-related supply constraints. Higher procurement costs: Milk procurement prices rose 11% YoY to ₹47.73/litre due to supply shortages and higher feed costs. Milk revenue growth: Q2 revenue grew 8.5% YoY, driven by 2.5% volume growth and price increases. Improved milk realisation: Average realisation increased 6% YoY to ₹60.34/litre. Strong Value-Added Products (VAP) growth: Revenue grew across key categories — Lassi (+91%), Ice Cream (+81%), Buttermilk (+66%), Paneer (+38%) and Curd (+26%). Strong volume growth in VAP: Lassi (+89%), Buttermilk (+56%), Ice Cream (+44%), Paneer (+21%) and Curd (+15%). Category milestones: Daily curd sales crossed 500 tonnes, yogurt volumes exceeded 100 tonnes for the quarter, and high-protein paneer contributed over 15% of the paneer portfolio.

Indian Railway Finance Corporation reported net profit of Rs 1958.48 crore in Q2FY27, up 10.2% from Rs 1,776.98 crore in Q2FY26.

Board declared an interim dividend of Rs 1.15 per share.

Shares traded at Rs 78.70 on the NSE, down 1%.

Indian Bank on Thursday reported a 15 per cent rise in net profit to Rs 3,462 crore for the second quarter ended September 30.

Heritage Foods reported standalone net profit for the quarter ended Sep 2026 at RS 30.51 crore, down 36.9% from Rs 48.40 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.

Shares fell over 5% to Rs 392.95 on the NSE.

Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances reported net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at Rs 20.18 crore compared to Rs 16.99 crore in September 2025 quarter.

Shares traded 7% higher at Rs 608 on the NSE.

Net Profit: ₹426.13 crore in Q2 FY 2026–27, registering a 21.28% YoY growth compared to ₹351.37 crore in Q2 FY 2025–26.

Net Interest Income (NII): Highest ever at ₹1,116 crore, with 37.95% YoY growth.

Operating Profit: Increased to ₹732 crore, registering 37% YoY growth.

Net Interest Margin (NIM): Improved to 3.33% from 2.80% YoY.

Gross Non-Performing Assets (GNPA): Reduced to 1.24% from 2.93%, an improvement of 169 basis points (bps).

Net Non-Performing Assets (NNPA): Declined to 0.09% from 0.56%, a reduction of 47 bps.

Provision Coverage Ratio (PCR), excluding write-offs: Increased to 92.42% from 81.29%, an improvement of 1,113 bps.

Provision Coverage Ratio (PCR), including write-offs: Increased to 97.84% from 90.25%, an improvement of 760 bps.

HDFC Asset Management Company posted standalone net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at Rs 749.81 crore, up 4% from Rs 718.06 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.

Shares traded 5% higher at Rs 2,411.50 on the NSE.

DBCORP: Q2 CONS NET PROFIT 686M RUPEES VS 935M (YOY); EST 1B DBCORP: Q2 EBITDA 910M RUPEES VS 1.38B (YOY); Q2 EBITDA MARGIN 15.66% VS 22.48% (YOY) DBCORP: Q2 REVENUE 5.8B RUPEES VS 6.14B (YOY)

Orient Electric reported net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at Rs 27.06 crore, compared to Rs 12.06 crore in September 2025 quarter.

Shares surged over 4% to Rs 180.68 on the NSE.

Karur Vysya Bank reported a 37.2% y-o-y increase in net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at Rs 787.69 crore, compared to Rs 573.96 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.

Tata Communications reported standalone PAT of Rs 125.86 crore in Q2FY27, down 40% from Rs 210.94 crore in Q2FY26.
